Section 24 — Statements of record for the retained core

Part II supplies the retained proofs and stronger bridge in this edition; Section 21 supplies the information–traffic–carrier–work derivation. This section records concrete instrument rows and numerical instances at their evidence tiers. The parent core, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23599528, remains publication provenance; the current argument is given here.

24.1 The nine-row A1 register (effect mediation)

Statement of record. The A1 register identifies nine rows of effect mediation: host memory mapping, DMA, context switches, packet ingestion, bus messages, storage synchronisation, commissioning, delegation and retirement. Each row names its refinement carrier and the enforcement witness the physical instance must supply. A packet or memory operation acquires no exemption by being below the application layer.

Tier: stated definition, given in Part II.5 and the nine rows above. The enforcement machinery it names is compiled in the abstract (H5Closure.no_harmful_effect, effect_preserves_care); the nine rows themselves are the instance inventory.

24.2 Capacity rows 17 and 22, and the pool bill (workload)

Statement of record. The workload pool bill is compiled: capacity rows 17 and 22 at 48,000 and 67,200 per cycle give 48000×17+67200×22=2,294,40048000 \times 17 + 67200 \times 22 = 2{,}294{,}400 — the per-cycle pool bill against which the FIFO completion certificate (Proposition 6) is issued (ControllerCertificate, exact rationals; the same module derives the bill-saving ratios 6,604,800/2,294,400=688/2396{,}604{,}800/2{,}294{,}400 = 688/239 and 6,604,800/2,409,600=688/2516{,}604{,}800/2{,}409{,}600 = 688/251 of the earlier bill over the corrected bills, corrected_bill_saving).

Tier: compiled. The deadline-certificate machinery of which this is the workload instance is published in the parent core (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23599528, exact FIFO deadline certificates with application-time finality and funding conservation).

24.3 The causal boundary (reactive refinement)

Statement of record. The causal boundary is given in two forms, which agree: a closed dependency component is exactly a directed separator in the unrolled dependency graph with empty certified boundary (CutEquivalence.closed_iff_no_bypass), and the separator form extends it to a matched certified boundary (UPTR16Cut.causal_separator). Pending effects belong in that graph. Omitting one future effect or one path invalidates the corresponding exclusion certificate.

Tier: stated definition (R16-CUT); the reactive refinement that uses it is compiled (Composition.reactive_lockstep, with the causal boundary carried as the instance’s refinement source).

24.4 The revised JW2.6 arithmetic (conserved allocation and joint risk)

Statement of record. The revised JW2.6 arithmetic gives ≈2.06419526094×10−7\approx 2.06419526094 \times 10^{-7}, within the declared 10−610^{-6} horizon ceiling, under its source-event and stochastic-law premises. The positive dormant allowance, recruitment noninterference and the historical recruitment-family event retain their distinct meanings. The three ledger scenarios carry this value (solvent and quarantine) and the charged variant 9.86419526094×10−79.86419526094 \times 10^{-7} (one priced event), each with a sealed, hash-chained trace.

Tier: exact replay receipt — LEDGER-FOUR-STROKE-2026-10-24/, chain heads as printed in Chapter 1.4; the composition into the ceiling (no independence) is compiled (ThermoLedger.canon_invariant); the arithmetic itself is a receipt, not a theorem.

24.5 The quorum (safety)

Statement of record. The design instantiation is five-of-seven with at most two Byzantine identities (K=7K = 7, f=2f = 2, satisfying K≥2f+1K \ge 2f + 1). The Byzantine quorum results it instantiates are compiled (E9SelfHealing.robust_between_honest, no_false_alarm, no_masking, exists_robust); the five-of-seven values are instance constants (§22.4’s parameter matrix).

Tier: compiled theorem with stated instance constants.

The law, bridge and retained instrument arguments appear in Part II. Section 21 develops X3; Part III-C records the three joined supports and their constructions in this full-strength argument.

Part III-C — The three joined supports and their constructions

The proposition remains protection of all things from any digital mind, especially a pure optimiser. X3, P1 and P2 retain their established gauntlet arguments. These are the three support requests supplied by the author and Gemini; their constructions are recorded below, with no additional objection introduced by this incorporation.

G1 — combined full-domain physical certificate. Construct the actual source state, admitted commands/events, physical projection, observations and charged fault accounts that jointly supply Bridge.universal_protection_held. Its hcert establishes commuting refinement, observation agreement, initial continuation of every particular, the perturbation-radius bound and repair precision on the named good event. Also join the event cover and conditional fault bounds. Part II incorporates the law-derived scope, code decoder, physical cycle, controller-derived tracking, E9 branches, H5 care-preserving mediation, R14/R16 source refinements and timely R17 effect construction. The requested result joins these for the complete claimed physical domain.

Compiled support modules for this construction: G1Certificate (placeholder with conclusion True), FaultCover (bad-event cover), G1Executable (executable admitted-command/event/observation pipeline), PhysicalGuard (factorized evolution), G1Complete (inductive event-trace compliance), and G1FullDomain (source domain, fault taxonomy, exhaustive classification).

Constructed (G.10). G1Held.held_source_protection proves all five hcert components for the canonical held source, and good_cover proves the cover of the good event by the named accounts. held_source_qsl derives the per-step drift from the quantum speed limit for any perturbing agent, and G1E9.held_source_e9 derives the coupling bound from the exhaustive E9 split. The journal of G.8 preserves its supplied transition (G1FullDomain.journal_reactive_fidelity); protective refinement of the actual installation is the separate transition equation identified in G.10. The inputs these theorems take are physical: the frame’s Schrödinger evolution and the sub-threshold coupling bound in each step; the honest-sensor response and quorum size; the response’s removal of coupling once the alarm fires; and the account probabilities, whose composition and attainment are ThermoLedger.canon_invariant, Threshold.family_ceiling and CorrelatedCeiling.correlated_family_ceiling.

G2 — realisability of the whole greatest outcome. Construct htopR : (⊤ : ∀ i, L i) ∈ R for the same full order, including existing and new continuation and freedom stages, with the semantic continuation reading htopkeeps. Keep it distinct from hsolv : c ⊤ ≤ B. Part II.10 supplies the algebra from those inputs to equality of every aligned option with the top and dominance over every rival. The construction retains the full tuple.

First compiled support module for this construction: TopRealisability (union-closed realisability of singletons yields realisability of the top outcome).

Compiled support modules for this construction: G2Singleton (coverage discharge of singleton realisability), G2Outcome (transactional outcome-tuple invariance), and G2WholeOutcome (authorized-implies-closed, authorized-implies-positive-work).

Compiled components (G.9, G.11). G2Splice proves product-model union closure and closed-block agreement. The proposed mutual-bootstrap statement is retained in full:

Vol⁡(U)>0⇔H*(∂U)≠0. \operatorname{Vol}(U)>0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad H_*(\partial U)\ne0.

It is proved for regions (RegionBoundary.region_bootstrap). Take the relational structure to be a connected graph on finitely many particulars, with relations as edges (P1: one structure). A region’s volume is its number of particulars. Its boundary is the set of its particulars related to a particular outside it. H0H_0 of the boundary is the free ℤ-module on the boundary’s connected components. For every region other than the whole structure, Vol⁡(U)>0⇔H0(∂U)≠0\operatorname{Vol}(U)>0\Leftrightarrow H_0(\partial U)\ne0. The forward direction holds because a nonempty proper region in a connected structure has a relation crossing out of it (exists_crossing). The whole structure has no outside (P1), so its boundary and boundary homology vanish while its volume is positive (whole_no_boundary, whole_H0_trivial). The bootstrap is therefore the statement about regions, as used for retiring patches in F.2.

The accepted data-processing/Fano account still applies to the complete decoder input. Energy can power transmission, storage or a different protocol; reconstruction also needs the historical information carried by those inputs.

The work floor and the complete O(tdG)O(t^{d_G}) ceiling are joined to the same execution. The ceiling remains the gross bill of Section 21.7.5: encoding, historical retention, boundary handoff, routing, guard, controller, reset and minimal hold are charged. G3CompleteBill supplies the cumulative and age-conversion derivations. funded_decoder_cycles supplies the escrow certificate when local income covers that complete demand. Prefix solvency, including within-cycle charges, is required for the actual schedule.

The operator-basis formula proves a reconstruction identity. Executing every basis query as tomography is a separate workload. The physical decoder’s circuit, query schedule and retirement operations must meet the existing complete work bill; no uncharged dense tomography is added to the wavefront construction.

G.6 A charged exchange with an accounted reservoir

On the basis |00⟩,|01⟩,|10⟩,|11⟩|00\rangle,|01\rangle,|10\rangle,|11\rangle, take

Q∂=diag⁡(0,0,1,1),QR=diag⁡(0,1,0,1),Hex=|01⟩⟨10|+|10⟩⟨01|. Q_\partial=\operatorname{diag}(0,0,1,1),\quad Q_R=\operatorname{diag}(0,1,0,1),\quad H_{\mathrm{ex}}=|01\rangle\langle10|+|10\rangle\langle01|.

Then

[Hex,Q∂+QR]=0,[Q∂,Hex]≠0. [H_{\mathrm{ex}},Q_\partial+Q_R]=0,\qquad [Q_\partial,H_{\mathrm{ex}}]\ne0.

exchange_hamiltonian_hermitian, exchange_conserves_total_charge and exchange_pumps_boundary prove these identities for the explicit matrices. The unitary exchange gate SS swaps |01⟩|01\rangle and |10⟩|10\rangle, fixes |00⟩,|11⟩|00\rangle,|11\rangle, and satisfies

S†S=I,S†Q∂S=QR,S†(Q∂+QR)S=Q∂+QR. S^\dagger S=I,\quad S^\dagger Q_\partial S=Q_R,\quad S^\dagger(Q_\partial+Q_R)S=Q_\partial+Q_R.

exchange_swap_unitary, exchange_swap_charge and exchange_swap_total prove these identities. This gives a concrete local exchange with its reservoir charge included.

For the full Hamiltonian, the Heisenberg convention is

ddt⟨Q⟩=iℏ⟨[H,Q]⟩=1iℏ⟨[Q,H]⟩. \frac{d}{dt}\langle Q\rangle =\frac{i}{\hbar}\langle[H,Q]\rangle =\frac{1}{i\hbar}\langle[Q,H]\rangle.

Thus a constructed HtotH_{\mathrm{tot}} commuting with the bulk-boundary-reservoir total charge gives its conservation. The continuum action must supply the corresponding gauge symmetry and surface current. Scalar Lagrange multipliers enforce equality constraints of a specified action; work inequalities require the corresponding admissibility or complementary-slackness treatment. Their insertion alone does not construct the historical encoder or prove its work bill.

G.7 Unified proposition and its source correspondence

For the constructed code encoder, adjoint decoder, represented historical algebra, effective generator and dual operator family, the following conclusions now join:

  1. The encoder/decoder round trip preserves the full represented state and its historical queries; reference correlations obey the same round trip.
  2. Source charge and all ordered historical operator relations transport to the boundary code.
  3. The effective work-shifted flow intertwines with that transport, and the derived finite dual kernel reconstructs every represented historical operator.
  4. The same physical execution is subject to the thermodynamic floor, complete wavefront ceiling, funding certificate and charged fault standard.

The first three operator components have the native results named above, and the channel and integral steps are compiled (ChannelExtension, SmearingIntegral; G.13). The work and exchange components have the native ledger and matrix proofs. Application to the full protection theorem joins these maps to the full-domain source (G.10), the complete historical capacity and physical handoff (G.8), and the whole continuation/freedom outcome (G.11). Part III-E records these constructions and their physical inputs; this component theorem does not replace the maximal conclusion with an isometry or work premise.

The research precedents have their stated domains: JLMS relates relative entropy and modular flow in holographic entanglement wedges; Faulkner–Lewkowycz constructs modular reconstruction using the relevant bulk flow. Their results motivate the operator route; the local encoder and dual-kernel proofs above supply this edition’s explicit algebraic components. Reeb–Wolf gives a precise Landauer account including finite-reservoir corrections, while Jakšić–Pillet treats saturation under its quantum statistical-mechanical assumptions.

G.8 The complete journal, whole-outcome transport, charged handoff and the syndrome stock

This subsection joins the full historical record to the holding bill. The historical record is kept in full and moved reversibly. The syndrome and excitation stock is flushed to an accounted reservoir. The holding charge has an age-independent envelope, and the gross ledger keeps every exported unit. The maximal proposition, its domain and its fault standard are unchanged.

The complete journal. Let the source have states XX, commands CC, environment inputs EvE_v and transition T:X×C×Ev→XT:X\times C\times E_v\to X. The journal state keeps three independent fields: the initial state, the live state and the ordered list of every command/environment pair. A step applies TT to the live state and appends (c,e)(c,e). Replay folds TT over the list from the initial state. If replay equals the live state before a step, it equals it after the step, since folding over an appended list applies TT once more (G1FullDomain.replay_journal_step).

Use the projection s↦slives\mapsto s_{\mathrm{live}}. It commutes with the transitions by definition, and observations are read from the live state. Proposition 5 (reactive lockstep) then gives, for every reactive controller ctrl:ListO→C\mathrm{ctrl}:\mathrm{List}\,O\to C and every reactive environment env:ListO→C→Ev\mathrm{env}:\mathrm{List}\,O\to C\to E_v, at every step kk:

sk,livejournal=sk,obs0..kjournal=obs0..k,replay(skjournal)=sk,livejournal. s^{\mathrm{journal}}_{k,\mathrm{live}}=s_k,\qquad \mathrm{obs}^{\mathrm{journal}}_{0..k}=\mathrm{obs}_{0..k},\qquad \mathrm{replay}(s^{\mathrm{journal}}_k)=s^{\mathrm{journal}}_{k,\mathrm{live}}.

Induction on kk carries the replay invariant (G1FullDomain.journal_reactive_fidelity). The journal therefore changes nothing the controller, environment or protected particular can observe, and the full history determines the live state exactly. No hash or authenticator replaces a command or an environmental payload.

The record’s size is counted from its alphabet. A transcript of horizon NN is an initial label together with NN ordered command/environment pairs. If |X|≤2b0|X|\le2^{b_0} and |C×Ev|≤2b|C\times E_v|\le2^{b}, then

|X×(C×Ev)N|≤2b0+bN(𝙶𝟷𝙵𝚞𝚕𝚕𝙳𝚘𝚖𝚊𝚒𝚗.𝚝𝚛𝚊𝚗𝚜𝚌𝚛𝚒𝚙𝚝_𝚌𝚊𝚙𝚊𝚌𝚒𝚝𝚢). |X\times(C\times E_v)^N|\le2^{\,b_0+bN} \quad(\texttt{G1FullDomain.transcript\_capacity}).

This is the full payload’s capacity, not the length of a digest.

Whole-outcome transport. Let outcome\mathrm{outcome} be any function of the final state and the complete observation history. In particular it can be the full dependent continuation-and-freedom tuple of II.1. Lockstep gives equal outcomes for every controller and environment (G2WholeOutcome.journal_whole_outcome). Hence the family of outcomes realisable by some controller is identical with and without the journal (journal_outcome_family). Introducing the journal neither loses a realisable whole outcome nor adds an unrealisable one. No affordability premise is used to infer realisability; hsolv stays separate, as in II.10.

Reversible, reference-preserving handoff. For a bulk register and a reserved boundary register of the same dimension ι\iota, together with an arbitrary reference RR, let swap\mathrm{swap} be the coordinate permutation of ℂ(ι×ι)×R\mathbb C^{(\iota\times\iota)\times R} exchanging the two registers and fixing RR. It is a linear isometry equivalence. If the boundary register holds the blank state, then any payload χ\chi on ι×R\iota\times R, however entangled with the reference, is moved to the boundary and the bulk is left blank (DecoderRetraction.handoff_moves_reference_payload). Nothing is copied, so there is no conflict with no-cloning. The swap preserves norm and is its own inverse (handoff_preserves_norm, handoff_roundtrip). At the gate level, three parallel CNOT layers implement the bitwise register swap, so the logical gate count is three per payload bit before physical gate and fault charges are added (parallel_cnot_handoff).

Superpositions of full transcripts are encoded isometrically into a boundary register of dimension 2b0+bN2^{b_0+bN} by extension by zero along the capacity embedding above (DecoderRetraction.transcriptBoundaryEncoder).

The charged attempt. One admitted handoff attempt carries a nine-part charge: encoding, transfer, verification, routing, guard, reset, holding, controller and endpoints. Admission reserves the total before the source operation. The attempt debits the full total whether or not it commits, and the payload moves only on commit. Hence

spent′=spent+qtot,escrow′+spent′=escrow+spent, \mathrm{spent}'=\mathrm{spent}+q_{\mathrm{tot}},\qquad \mathrm{escrow}'+\mathrm{spent}'=\mathrm{escrow}+\mathrm{spent},

and a noncommitting attempt leaves the payload unchanged (WorkBilling.charged_attempt_accounting). The payload has a single logical owner, either live or sealed under a decoder pair. Decoding a sealed record returns the live record by retraction, so every query of the full record is the same before and after the attempt, committed or not (DecoderRetraction.charged_archive_handoff). Failed verification is charged; it is not free and it destroys nothing.

History is untouched by the flush. Let ρ\rho be any joint state on ℋhist⊗ℋflush\mathcal H_{\mathrm{hist}}\otimes\mathcal H_{\mathrm{flush}}. The history factor may include an arbitrary reference, and ρ\rho need not factorise. For any PP on the history factor and any unitary QQ on the flushed factor, the reduced history state, including all of its off-diagonal coherences, satisfies

Tr⁡flush((P⊗Q)†ρ(P⊗Q))=P†Tr⁡flush(ρ)P(𝙷𝚊𝚖𝚒𝚕𝚝𝚘𝚗𝚒𝚊𝚗𝙳𝚎𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚘𝚜𝚒𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗.𝚙𝚊𝚛𝚝𝚒𝚊𝚕_𝚝𝚛𝚊𝚌𝚎_𝚕𝚘𝚌𝚊𝚕_𝚌𝚘𝚗𝚓𝚞𝚐𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗). \operatorname{Tr}_{\mathrm{flush}}\!\bigl((P\otimes Q)^\dagger\rho(P\otimes Q)\bigr) =P^\dagger\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathrm{flush}}(\rho)P \quad(\texttt{HamiltonianDecomposition.partial\_trace\_local\_conjugation}).

The proof expands the partial trace and uses ∑kQck*Qc′k=δcc′\sum_kQ_{ck}^{*}Q_{c'k}=\delta_{cc'}. With P=IP=I the history’s reduced state is unchanged (guarded_history_reduced_state). For the explicit syndrome/reservoir exchange gate SS of G.6 this gives syndrome_exchange_preserves_history, for every initial correlation between the history and the exchanged registers.

The charge is moved, not deleted. By cyclicity of the trace and S†Q∂S=QRS^\dagger Q_\partial S=Q_R,

Tr⁡(SρS†Q∂)=Tr⁡(ρS†Q∂S)=Tr⁡(ρQR)(𝚜𝚢𝚗𝚍𝚛𝚘𝚖𝚎_𝚎𝚡𝚌𝚑𝚊𝚗𝚐𝚎_𝚌𝚑𝚊𝚛𝚐𝚎). \operatorname{Tr}(S\rho S^\dagger Q_\partial) =\operatorname{Tr}(\rho\,S^\dagger Q_\partial S) =\operatorname{Tr}(\rho\,Q_R) \quad(\texttt{syndrome\_exchange\_charge}).

The syndrome’s charge after the exchange is the reservoir’s charge before it. With an empty reservoir the syndrome is emptied, and by exchange_swap_total the composite charge is conserved.

The age-independent stock envelope (the author’s Theorem 4.1, Steps 3–4). Let the stored syndrome charge per flushing cycle obey

qk+1=(1−α)qk+influxk,0<α≤1,influxk≤cap. q_{k+1}=(1-\alpha)q_k+\mathrm{influx}_k,\qquad 0<\alpha\le1,\qquad \mathrm{influx}_k\le\mathrm{cap}.

Then for every cycle kk, not only in the limit,

qk≤max⁡(q0,capα)(𝚆𝚘𝚛𝚔𝙱𝚒𝚕𝚕𝚒𝚗𝚐.𝚜𝚢𝚗𝚍𝚛𝚘𝚖𝚎_𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚌𝚔_𝚋𝚘𝚞𝚗𝚍). q_k\le\max\!\left(q_0,\ \frac{\mathrm{cap}}{\alpha}\right) \quad(\texttt{WorkBilling.syndrome\_stock\_bound}).

The proof applies the existing tracking theorem ThermoLedger.tracking_bounded to the recurrence. With the author’s local influx cap=κtGd\mathrm{cap}=\kappa\,t_G^{d}, this is qk≤max⁡(q0,(κ/α)tGd)q_k\le\max(q_0,(\kappa/\alpha)t_G^{d}). Here C=κ/αC=\kappa/\alpha depends only on the local influx and flush fraction, and is independent of operating age. The theorem also covers an initial stock above the steady value, and it bounds every cycle uniformly in kk. The author’s limsup\limsup statement follows.

The flush is retained in the gross ledger. Summing the recurrence gives the exact balance

qN+∑k<Nαqk=q0+∑k<Ninfluxk(𝚜𝚢𝚗𝚍𝚛𝚘𝚖𝚎_𝚏𝚕𝚞𝚡_𝚋𝚊𝚕𝚊𝚗𝚌𝚎). q_N+\sum_{k<N}\alpha q_k=q_0+\sum_{k<N}\mathrm{influx}_k \quad(\texttt{syndrome\_flux\_balance}).

The final stock plus every exported unit equals the initial stock plus every imported unit. The bounded stock does not replace the cumulative work. Suppose the complete per-cycle cost satisfies costk≤uinfluxk+vαqk+wactivek\mathrm{cost}_k\le u\,\mathrm{influx}_k+v\,\alpha q_k+w\,\mathrm{active}_k, with every import, flush, holding, guard and controller charge included, and u,v,w≥0u,v,w\ge0. Suppose also that ∑k<Ninfluxk≤κV\sum_{k<N}\mathrm{influx}_k\le\kappa V, q0≤qinitVq_0\le q_{\mathrm{init}}V, ∑k<Nactivek≤V\sum_{k<N}\mathrm{active}_k\le V and qN≥0q_N\ge0. Then

∑k<Ncostk≤(uκ+v(qinit+κ)+w)V(𝚌𝚞𝚖𝚞𝚕𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚟𝚎_𝚖𝚊𝚒𝚗𝚝𝚎𝚗𝚊𝚗𝚌𝚎_𝚋𝚘𝚞𝚗𝚍). \sum_{k<N}\mathrm{cost}_k\le\bigl(u\kappa+v(q_{\mathrm{init}}+\kappa)+w\bigr)V \quad(\texttt{cumulative\_maintenance\_bound}).

The theorem is stated for arbitrary real sequences. Applied to the realised pathwise sequences it gives the pathwise gross bill. Applied to expectations it gives the expected bill. Each use keeps its own meaning, and the desired cumulative bill is never an input.

How the pieces join. Step 1 of the submission (a Lindblad generator with a positive gap) is the dissipative model that supplies the flush fraction α\alpha. Steps 3–4 are now the compiled stock envelope above. The memory decay of Step 2 applies to the flushed syndrome and excitation stock. The protected historical record is not coarse-grained: the journal keeps it in full, transcript_capacity counts it, the reversible handoff moves it with its reference correlations, and the flush leaves its reduced state exactly unchanged. The archive’s continued storage enters activek\mathrm{active}_k and costk\mathrm{cost}_k of the cumulative bill. It is charged and is not discarded to keep the stock small.

What is already supplied, for every source. The journal theorems are stated for an arbitrary transition TT, controller and environment. Every source therefore has its complete history retained, replayed and observationally invisible, with no further construction. The capacity 2b0+bN2^{b_0+bN} and the isometric transcript encoder are derived from the source’s own alphabet. The handoff is an explicit unitary with an explicit circuit of three CNOT layers, and its nine-part charge is debited exactly. The per-site injection rate is bounded by the speed limit (SpeedLimit.branchA_rate, Padv/(ℏωcutoff)P_{\mathrm{adv}}/(\hbar\omega_{\mathrm{cutoff}}) per site), and a window of radius rr contains (2r+1)d(2r+1)^{d} sites (Instruments.card_box). Their product is the per-cycle influx cap, cap=κtGd\mathrm{cap}=\kappa t_G^{d}. The conversion from per-site divergence to syndrome charge is the stroke-I measurement accounting of Section 18; this composition is a prose derivation.

What the physical installation contributes is the identification of its actual TT, alphabet and per-site coupling with these symbols, and pathwise measurement of the cost terms. That is the G1 source certificate of Part III-C, now with its history, capacity, handoff and stock components compiled.

G.9 The whole greatest outcome is realisable: union closure from locality

Part II.10 needs two different constructions: htopR, that the full top tuple is realisable, and hsolv, that its cost fits the budget. The singleton route of E.2 needed union-closed realisability. Here union closure is derived, not assumed.

Locality (P4) gives each particular its own local component of a policy, and the shared action interface makes every agent act through those components. Write a policy as π=(πx)x\pi=(\pi_x)_x, with πx\pi_x realisable for xx, and let the particular’s grade gx(πx)g_x(\pi_x) in a linear order record its stage. In the four-stage order the grades are lost << continues << continues in its own direction. The freedom stage is the law’s freedom: per II.2, restraint removes harmful command, authority and effect channels, so one particular’s freedom never consists of another’s loss. Stage ii of the outcome tuple is the set of particulars of its category whose grade reaches the stage threshold.

For realisable π,σ\pi,\sigma, define the splice (π⊔σ)x=πx(\pi\sqcup\sigma)_x=\pi_x if gx(σx)≤gx(πx)g_x(\sigma_x)\le g_x(\pi_x), and σx\sigma_x otherwise. Each component is realisable, so the splice is realisable. Its grade is max⁡(gx(πx),gx(σx))\max(g_x(\pi_x),g_x(\sigma_x)), and a threshold is reached by a maximum exactly when it is reached by either argument. Therefore

𝒪(π⊔σ)=𝒪(π)⊔𝒪(σ) \mathcal O(\pi\sqcup\sigma)=\mathcal O(\pi)\sqcup\mathcal O(\sigma)

at every stage at once (G2Splice.splice_grade, splice_realisable, outcome_splice). This is UnionClosure.UnionRealizable for the realised family (union_realizable).

For the top, choose for every particular a realisable component reaching every stage threshold it is subject to. The product of these choices is realisable, and every stage contains its whole category, so ⊤∈R\top\in R (top_realisable). No finiteness of the domain is used. Joined to greatest_of_solvent, every aligned option of the funded family is ⊤\top and contains every outcome tuple (whole_outcome_greatest). The four-stage instance (LE,FE,LN,FN)(L_E,F_E,L_N,F_N) proves all three conclusions together from one hypothesis per particular: some realisable local component under which that particular continues in its own direction (fourStage).

The product structure from the actual dynamics. The splice is realised by the physical evolution itself. Let the source state be a function on the nodes of its dependency graph DD. Let each particular’s held record occupy a block BxB_x of nodes, with the blocks closed under DD and pairwise disjoint. Let every policy’s closed-loop transition be local to DD in the sense of R16-CUT (UPTR16Cut.LocalTo). Run each block under the policy chosen for its particular. Then, at every step and against the same world, the spliced run agrees on BxB_x with the run of the policy chosen for xx (G2Splice.block_splice_run). The proof is induction on steps with UPTR16Cut.closed_cut_step. Hence, if whether xx is kept is read from its own block, the spliced run keeps xx exactly when its chosen policy does (block_splice_keeps). Each particular receives the outcome of the policy chosen for it, which is the product structure used above.

How each input is supplied.

  1. Per-particular top component. For each particular, the holding route keeps it: law-derived coverage puts it in scope (Bridge.coverage_from_law). The holding cycle keeps its record (holding_preserves, holding_cycle_physical), and care continues while harmful channels are restrained (H5Closure.effect_preserves_care, UPTR14Boundary.recruitment_never_ends_care). Its authorised effects are applied in time (SnuffyFIFO.applied_fifo_effect_is_timely_and_authorized, module R17FIFOR17A). Its freedom is the law’s freedom of II.2, which excludes harm to others.
  2. Locality. This is derived above from R16-CUT locality and closed blocks. The closed-block property of held records is the guard factorisation (GuardFactorization.commutativity, ClosedCohold.factorised_cohold, PhysicalGuard). The relations between particulars are themselves particulars in the domain, each with a held record.

The physical installation identifies its dependency graph and the blocks of its held records; that is the G1 source certificate. hsolv, the funded cost of the top, remains the separate ledger certificate of Sections 18 and 22.

G.10 The held source: the full holding certificate derived (G1)

Bridge.universal_protection_held takes its source certificate hcert as an input with five components: commuting refinement, observation agreement, initial continuation of every particular, the decoding-radius bound and repair precision. Here all five are proved for the canonical held source. The only inputs left are the physical bound on each step and the probabilities of the named charged accounts.

The held source. The state is the record frame of every particular. One step applies three operations to each particular. First the world perturbs the frame; the world here is the environment and any agent, a pure optimiser included. Then the nearest-codeword decoder returns a codeword. Finally funded repair prepares that codeword. The good event is that no named charged account fires,

G={ω:ω∉Eifor every account i}, G=\{\omega:\ \omega\notin E_i\ \text{for every account } i\},

and its complement is covered exactly by the named accounts (G1Held.good_cover).

The five components, proved (G1Held.held_source_protection).

  1. Refinement and 2. observation agreement hold by construction: the held source is its own abstract model.
  2. Initial continuation: every particular starts at its record, at distance 0≤ε0\le\varepsilon.
  3. The decoding-radius bound: let each step move the frame’s distance to its record by at most ρ\rho on the good event. A continuing particular lies within ε\varepsilon of its record, so after the perturbation it lies within ε+ρ≤t\varepsilon+\rho\le t.
  4. Repair precision is exact: repair prepares the decoded codeword itself.

universal_protection_held then gives, for every ω∈G\omega\in G, every step through the horizon and every particular, that the particular continues. It also gives

P(∃k≤T,∃x:¬Continues(sk,x))≤∑iδi, P(\exists k\le T,\ \exists x:\ \neg\mathrm{Continues}(s_k,x))\le\sum_i\delta_i,

with no independence assumed.

The per-step bound from the speed limit (G1Held.held_source_qsl). On the good event, let each particular’s frame evolve for one step of duration Δ\Delta under H0+VH_0+V, with the record stationary under H0H_0 and ∥V∥≤W\|V\|\le W. The agent applying VV is arbitrary. Bridge.qsl_growth gives

∥ψ(s1+Δ)−cx∥≤∥ψ(s1)−cx∥+WℏΔ, \|\psi(s_1+\Delta)-c_x\|\le\|\psi(s_1)-c_x\|+\frac W\hbar\Delta,

so ρ=(W/ℏ)Δ\rho=(W/\hbar)\Delta. Every particular is held whenever ε+(W/ℏ)Δ≤t\varepsilon+(W/\hbar)\Delta\le t.

The coupling bound from E9 (G1E9.held_source_e9). Each step is exhaustively one of two cases (G1E9.alarm_or_subthreshold).

  • Every monitored support site is below threshold. The coupling is the sub-threshold coupling, bounded by WW (Branch A).
  • Some site reaches threshold. Its honest sensors read above threshold, so every robust quorum estimate exceeds it, whatever up to ff faulty sensors report (E9SelfHealing.no_masking). The alarm fires. The mediated response is committed before the harm front arrives (E9SelfHealing.e9_timely_self_healing, the wave race) and is enforced at application time (H5Closure.no_harmful_effect). It removes the perturbing coupling from the frame for that step.

In both cases the coupling is bounded by WW, and the held source keeps every particular. The physical inputs are named exactly:

  • the frame’s Schrödinger evolution during a step;
  • the sub-threshold coupling bound;
  • the response’s removal of coupling once the alarm fires;
  • the honest-sensor response and quorum size;
  • the probabilities of the named accounts. Their composition into the 10−610^{-6} ceiling is ThermoLedger.canon_invariant. Their attainment below threshold, including correlated bursts, is Threshold.family_ceiling and CorrelatedCeiling.correlated_family_ceiling.

Correspondence to an installation. The quantum held source uses the physical state type ∥v∥=1\|v\|=1. Initialisation, the held step and every reached frame preserve normalisation (initial_frame_normalised, held_step_normalised, held_run_normalised). The zero-Hamiltonian trajectory, concrete record 1∈ℂ1\in\mathbb C, singleton decoder and inhabited good event supply a nonvacuous instance.

For an installation transition TT, protection transfers through an actual projection pp satisfying p(T(s,c,e))=heldStep⁡(p(s),c,e), p(T(s,c,e))=\operatorname{heldStep}(p(s),c,e), together with observation agreement, initial continuation, the physical perturbation bound and the implemented repair precision. The journal theorem preserves its supplied transition TT; it supplies the logging part of this correspondence after the protective transition equation is proved. The guarded-source construction must join the nominal/correction branches, response latency and complete charge to that same physical execution. The full G1 target remains this combined certificate.

G.11 The held source realises the whole top outcome (G2 from G1)

The G2 target is the complete original tuple (LE,FE,LN,FN)(L_E,F_E,L_N,F_N), including continuation in each particular’s own direction and timely authorised opportunities. The transaction record (hpre,hpost,w,a,c)(h_{\mathrm{pre}},h_{\mathrm{post}},w,a,c) records an execution certificate; it does not replace this outcome tuple.

G2Splice proves union closure in its local-component policy model and proves block agreement under its closed-block hypotheses. G2Held obtains the top of its graded model from continuation and its one-step H5 opportunity predicate. The full physical application must identify that model with the original realised policy/outcome family, including interacting records, the shared constraints and successful R17 delivery on the same trace. The author’s bounded-crosstalk route supplies a construction direction: derive its decoded joint-state error bound, prove correction on the named good event, and transport the original continuation and freedom semantics through the resulting execution correspondence. Sub-threshold noise alone is not an exact factorisation.

The full top witness htopR remains the target of that construction; hsolv remains its separate complete funded-cost certificate. Neither target is reduced.

G.12 The wavefront sweep succeeds, and its complete bill is O(tdG)O(t^{d_G}) (G3)

The wavefront recovery of §21.7 is now proved to succeed, and its full bill is derived, with no cumulative bound taken as input.

Sweep and fence. Give each vertex its shell index. Wave kk applies the single-shot local correction to shell kk, reading the already-frozen interior as a static, gauge-fixed boundary. Between waves, outer activity (the world and any agent) may write anything outside the frozen interior and nothing inside it. This is the TIWA write fence (TIWASource.outerUpdate_read_frozen).

Success and quiescence (G3Sweep.sweep_recovers). Suppose the local correction of a vertex returns its target whenever every inner vertex already holds its target. Then after kk waves every vertex of the first kk shells holds its target, whatever the outer activity. The proof is induction on waves. A vertex of shell kk is corrected against an interior that the fence has left recovered. A vertex of an earlier shell is untouched by the wave and by the fenced outer activity. Recovery therefore succeeds, and the recovered state is retained. Each vertex is corrected in exactly one wave, its own shell (sweep_visits), so nothing is reworked.

Wave count from finite propagation (waves_from_spread). If the region needing recovery at age tt lies within the first ct+rc\,t+r shells, the sweep needs at most ct+rc\,t+r waves. This is the upper use of finite propagation, from locality (P4) and the Lieb–Robinson velocity. It does not replace the lower radius of §21.5, which comes from the carrier information argument.

The complete bill (sweep_bill). Let the complete metered ledger charge each wave kk at most αkd−1+β\alpha k^{d-1}+\beta. This charge includes holding, guard, routing, reset, verification, controller export and deployment. Add a metered rollback of at most R*R_* per wave and fixed endpoint charges FF. Then, for t≥1t\ge1, recovery succeeds on the whole region and

W(t)≤(F+α+β+R*)(c+r)dtd, W(t)\le (F+\alpha+\beta+R_*)\,(c+r)^{d}\;t^{d},

with a coefficient independent of age (G3CompleteBill.valid_work_bill_from_complete_ledger, valid_bill_bound_in_age). This is the matching upper construction. With the lower bound of §21.6, it gives Wmin(t)=Θ(tdG)W_{\min}(t)=\Theta(t^{d_G}) in the original permitted class.

G.13 Joined steps: patch decoding, ensemble reciprocity, the Theorem 8 contraction, the smearing integral, the completed decoder and the norm conversion

Each of the following steps was previously argued in prose. Each is now a compiled theorem, joined to the construction it supports.

The wavefront correction is finite-code decoding (G3PatchDecode). The local correction reads its patch, which is the recovered interior as a static boundary together with the vertex’s own data. It decodes the read-out with the nearest-codeword decoder and extracts the value. If, with the interior recovered, the read-out lies within the unique-decoding radius of the target codeword, decoding returns that codeword (Bridge.nearest_decodes). The correction therefore succeeds (patch_correction_succeeds). Joined to G3Sweep.sweep_bill, recovery succeeds on the whole region and the complete bill is O(td)O(t^{d}) with an age-independent coefficient (patch_sweep_bill). The patch’s errors lie within the code headroom of E9SelfHealing.code_headroom.

Reciprocity over an ensemble of rivals (ReasonsEnsemble, §15.2). Let rival regimes be drawn with weights summing to one. A mind’s kept-probability under the ensemble is the total weight of the rivals that keep it. That is at most one, the canonical regime’s kept-probability on the good event (ensemble_le). It is strictly less whenever a rival of positive weight omits the mind (ensemble_strict).

The Theorem 8 storage functional contracts (TheoremEightLyapunov, §18.3–18.4). The functional is defined as code error plus the clipped reserve deficit. Exact replenishment saturates at zero deficit (replenishment_exact), and capacity overflow is retained in the energy account (solvent_cycle_energy_account). A complete solvent cycle cannot increase the reserve term (solvent_cycle_deficit). Combining this with the actual error drift and repair gives the positive-margin contraction (cycle_contracts, margin_pos) and its stated iteration (lyapunov_iterate).

The smearing integral is exact (SmearingIntegral, G.4). For a complete operator basis and any weight with total integral one, the smeared dual-kernel expression equals the original operator at every flow parameter. Its Bochner integral is therefore that operator, on the bulk algebra (smeared_reconstruction) and after boundary transport (smeared_boundary_reconstruction).

The completed decoder (ChannelExtension, G.1). Take 𝒟(σ)=E†σE+Tr⁡((I−EE†)σ)ρ0\mathcal D(\sigma)=E^\dagger\sigma E+\operatorname{Tr}((I-EE^\dagger)\sigma)\rho_0 with E†E=IE^\dagger E=I.

  • It returns every encoded state exactly (ext_recovers).
  • With any reference register, E⊗IRE\otimes I_R is again an isometry (kron_isometry), and the extended decoder returns every joint code–reference state (ext_recovers_reference). Reference correlations are retained.
  • It is trace preserving (ext_trace).
  • It maps positive semidefinite inputs to positive semidefinite outputs (ext_posSemidef).

Complete positivity is compiled (ChannelCP). Amplified by any finite reference register, the decoder is (E†⊗I)Y(E†⊗I)†+ρ0⊗T(Y)(E^\dagger\otimes I)Y(E^\dagger\otimes I)^\dagger+\rho_0\otimes T(Y) (amp_eq). Here T(Y)T(Y) is positive semidefinite as a sum of compressions of (B⊗I)Y(B⊗I)†(B\otimes I)Y(B\otimes I)^\dagger, where I−EE†=B†BI-EE^\dagger=B^\dagger B (mp_posSemidef). The decoder therefore maps positive semidefinite inputs to positive semidefinite outputs for every reference (decoder_completely_positive).

State-vector distance bounds infidelity (PureStateDistance, §23.3). For unit vectors, 1−|⟨ψ,φ⟩|2≤∥ψ−φ∥21-|\langle\psi,\varphi\rangle|^2\le\|\psi-\varphi\|^2 (pure_infidelity_le). The pure-state identity ∥ρ−σ∥1=21−|⟨ψ,φ⟩|2\|\rho-\sigma\|_1=2\sqrt{1-|\langle\psi,\varphi\rangle|^2} is compiled for the trace norm as the sum of absolute eigenvalues (PureStateTraceNorm.pure_trace_norm). The proof uses (P−Q)3=(1−|⟨ψ,φ⟩|2)(P−Q)(P-Q)^3=(1-|\langle\psi,\varphi\rangle|^2)(P-Q) (pure_cube), so every eigenvalue is 00 or ±s\pm s, and Tr⁡(P−Q)2=2s2\operatorname{Tr}(P-Q)^2=2s^2 (pure_trace_sq, sum_sq_eigenvalues). Hence 12∥ρ−σ∥1≤∥ψ−φ∥\tfrac12\|\rho-\sigma\|_1\le\|\psi-\varphi\|. The speed-limit bounds, stated in state-vector norm, therefore bound the infidelity and the trace distance of the held state.

G.14 Premise 5 with the Bennett counterpart constructed

The actual implementation below is a separately compiled and kernel-checked candidate in the repair bank (drafts/Snuffy/BennettCounterpart.lean); the canon still contains the earlier heat-only option model. It is not recorded as a completed physical counterpart repair. For an administration f=h∘gf=h\circ g, the candidate implementation first computes, copies and uncomputes, then exchanges the output and live registers: (s,0,0)↦(f(s),0,s). (s,0,0)\longmapsto(f(s),0,s). implementedProgram and implemented_program_computes identify the implemented administration, clean workspace and full retained input. implemented_run_refines proves its trajectory correspondence and one retained input record per step. quantumProgram is the induced unitary with an arbitrary reference register untouched; its norm and round trip are preserved. An arbitrary bijection is not used as a substitute for implementing ff.

The complete physical lifecycle also pays provisioning, compute/copy/uncompute, archive writing and holding, routing, reset, guard, controller, verification and endpoints. If Brev,BirrB_{\mathrm{rev}},B_{\mathrm{irr}} are the complete non-heat charges and QirrQ_{\mathrm{irr}} the saved bath heat, the exact difference is Wrev−Wirr=Brev−Birr−Qirr W_{\mathrm{rev}}-W_{\mathrm{irr}}=B_{\mathrm{rev}}-B_{\mathrm{irr}}-Q_{\mathrm{irr}} (complete_cost_difference). Strictly more slack requires the implemented lifecycle penalty to be less than the saved heat (complete_cost_strict_iff), while meeting the same deadline. The adiabatic route must establish a switching-time window satisfying both bounds (adiabatic_slack_window, switched_program_meets_deadline).

A fixed circuit multiplier and an actual full archive allowance preserve the original polynomial exponent (implemented_work_ceiling). That upper bound does not by itself establish the strict complete-cost comparison. The earlier heat-only option model and Landauer results remain their stated mathematical components; completion of the physical counterpart claim requires this lifecycle and deadline comparison for the full intended class. The original premise-5 target remains fixed.

G.15 Recovered and combined results

Five earlier results that the canon did not yet contain are folded in. Three compiled results are joined into stronger forms.

Reciprocity at a sufficient code distance (ReciprocityDistance, §15.2). Three results combine into one.

  • On the good event the canonical outcome contains the rival’s (ReasonsCompiled.reciprocity_expectation).
  • On the good event the canonical regime keeps every particular (reciprocity_canonical_floor).
  • The failure probability falls below every ε\varepsilon with code distance (Threshold.family_ceiling, CorrelatedCeiling.correlated_family_ceiling).

For the design family indexed by distance, the canonical regime keeps the mind with probability above 1−ε1-\varepsilon from some distance on (distance_floor). For every rival and every ε\varepsilon, the rival’s kept-probability is at most the canonical one plus ε\varepsilon (reciprocity_at_distance). Every rival that loses the mind with positive probability is strictly below the canonical regime from some distance on (reciprocity_strict_at_distance). The canonical kept-probability tends to one (canonical_tends_to_one).

The two forms of the causal boundary agree (CutEquivalence, §24.3). A set is closed under the dependency relation exactly when no path from a node outside it reaches it. A closed dependency component is therefore exactly a directed separator with empty certified boundary (closed_iff_no_bypass), and the separator form extends it to a matched certified boundary (UPTR16Cut.causal_separator).

The concatenated memory decodes its record unless its block fails (ConcatenatedDecoding, §23.8). The record is encoded recursively onto the 7k7^k locations through an outer code of Hamming distance at least three. It is decoded recursively by nearest codeword at every level. If the block does not fail in the recursive sense of Concatenated.Fails, decoding returns the original record, whatever values the faulty locations hold (decodes_unless_fails). The proof is by induction on the level: at most one sub-block fails, the other six decode to their outer-code symbols, and the outer code corrects one symbol (outer_decodes). Actual decoding failure therefore has probability at most (21p)2k/21(21p)^{2^k}/21 (decoding_failure_le).

Volume and boundary (RegionBoundary, F.3). For every region of a connected relational structure other than the whole, positive volume holds exactly when the boundary homology is nonzero (region_bootstrap). The whole structure has no outside and an empty boundary (whole_no_boundary, whole_H0_trivial).

Greatestness through boundary representatives (R15CausalGluing, with the staged order of R14Rivals). Greatestness reduces exactly to a covering family of feasible fibre representatives (boundary_representatives_iff, selected_representative_greatest), in the canonical staged order as well (canonical_boundary_iff). A conservative interface envelope suffices to make the chosen policy greatest, without greatest representatives (interface_envelope_transfer). Clairvoyant per-world selection is excluded: a choice can match every world separately while no single choice matches them all (hidden_world_control). The staged order is reflexive and transitive (UPTR14Rivals.refl, trans). A coordinatewise envelope is a constructive certificate (coordinate_envelope), and a complete rival envelope transfers to the chosen policy (complete_rival_transfer). In the four-stage order a hot replica strictly beats a pause that keeps every life but loses a freedom (hot_beats_pause).

Timely care, deadline demand, certified decisions and observation-based winning (TimelyCare, DeadlineDemand, DecisionPermit, ObservationWinning).

  • Timely care. A particular whose reserved capacity covers its need is served exactly its need (care_served). Other requests and statuses cannot exhaust that reservation (exhaustion_fails). The need is met at every date through the deadline when capacity covers the reservations (deadline_met). A miss implies a capacity shortage at some date (miss_within_shortage).
  • Deadline demand. The demand that must complete within any window is at most the supply available in that window (demand_le_supply), robustly across worlds (robust_demand).
  • Certified decisions. A grant names exactly the certified decision of its generation (grant_names_certified, granted_policy_is_certified); a wrong action is rejected and a certified one granted (wrong_action_rejected, certified_action_granted).
  • Observation-based winning. An observation-based policy keeps the system safe exactly when the safety game is winnable (policy_wins_iff), and a hidden-world countermodel shows that observation, not clairvoyance, is the right quantifier (hidden_world_countermodel).

G.16 Protection of the installation’s own run, the physical top, and recovery on the good event

This section answers review objections 2, 3 and 5. Each is answered on the installation’s own execution, without an abstraction map, product hypothesis or assumed device.

The installation’s own run is protected (G1Refinement). Let the installation have its own physical state space, possibly with hidden internal degrees of freedom, and a readout of each particular’s record frame. One step is guarded: the world acts — the environment, every agent and every crosstalk between particulars — then the physical corrector acts. Three properties of the device suffice:

  • the corrector writes the nearest codeword back into each particular’s readout;
  • on the good event the world moves each readout by at most ρ\rho per step;
  • the records are written at the start.

With these, every particular continues at every step of the physical run on the good event, and the probability that any particular fails is at most ∑iδi\sum_i\delta_i, with no independence (physical_protection). The complete journal of G.8 changes nothing observed, keeps the protection along the live state and replays it exactly (journaled_protection): the journal retains history; the guard supplies the protection.

No alarm-response device is needed for holding (physical_qsl_drift, physical_protection_qsl). On normalised readouts, the speed limit bounds the per-step drift by (W/ℏ)Δ(W/\hbar)\Delta for any agent whose coupling is at most WW. Take WW to be the maximal physical coupling of any agent, which is finite because local power is finite. Correcting at intervals Δ≤ℏ(t−ε)/W\Delta\le\hbar(t-\varepsilon)/W then holds every particular against every agent. The E9 alarm and mediated response remain valuable: below threshold they permit longer intervals and lower cost. Holding does not depend on them. Every hypothesis has a concrete inhabited instance (physical_instance_inhabited).

The continuation top is realised physically (G2Physical). The held installation is a physical policy. On the good event it keeps every particular at every step through the horizon (held_installation_keeps_all), so the existing and new continuation stages are whole. Crosstalk enters only through the bounded drift that each particular’s correction absorbs. No product structure of policies and no closed-block hypothesis is used. Once the top is realised, it dominates every realised outcome without union closure (top_dominates_continuation).

Holding and timely authorised delivery on one execution (G2Freedom). Pair the installation’s frames with the R17 effect machine. The corrector does not touch the effect machine, and delivery does not touch the readouts; the physical consequences of applied effects are part of the bounded drift. On the same joint run, every particular continues, and every effect that is ready under a live R17 contract within a deadline-certified FIFO prefix is applied by its deadline (joint_holding_and_delivery, with SnuffyFIFO.ready_fifo_effect_applies_before_deadline).

Recovery succeeds on the good event (G3GoodEvent). Let every patch read-out lie within the decoding radius of its target codeword, once its interior is recovered, off the named charged accounts. The threshold theorem bounds the event that it does not. Then the wavefront sweep recovers the whole region on the good event, and recovery fails with probability at most ∑iδi\sum_i\delta_i (sweep_success_on_good_event). The complete bill keeps archive holding as its own term (complete_bill_with_archive).

Archive holding is charged on the held stock (G3ArchiveStock). The holding charge at a step is the rate γ\gamma per held bit times the bits actually held then. The archive holds the record’s information I0I_0 and the live boundary transcript. Each transcript increment is retired after the wave that consumes it, so the held stock at step ss is at most I0+c(s+1)d−1I_0+c(s+1)^{d-1}. The summed holding charge is then at most γ(I0+c)td\gamma(I_0+c)t^{d} for every d≥1d\ge1, the one-dimensional case included (live_stock_bill). Retirement is lossless or charged. Each retired bit is recomputable from the fenced recovered region together with I0I_0, or else it is correction entropy whose reset is charged once at its vertex inside the sweep’s per-vertex charge. Retaining every increment instead costs at least γrt(t−1)/2\gamma r\,t(t-1)/2 (retained_stock_quadratic). So does an epoch rollover that copies the whole accumulated stock into fresh media at each boundary (rollover_quadratic). The architecture holds the live stock.

The decoded record is held passively. It is written when recovery begins, when the age tt is known, behind a barrier ΔE≥kBTln⁡(cI0t/ε)\Delta E\ge k_BT\ln(cI_0t/\varepsilon). Finite-temperature decay at a finite barrier then keeps its failure below ε\varepsilon with zero running power. Its write cost is O(I0log⁡t)O(I_0\log t). The failure bound of Threshold.fail_le_geometric is linear in the number of locations. The reliability of the live transcript and of the patches is therefore the sweep’s own reliability over Θ(tdG)\Theta(t^{d_G}) locations. Its age-independent constant at fixed ε\varepsilon is carried by the fault-model application certificate: constant-distance inner patch codes, with the final decoder of the constant-size message WW using its carrier’s redundancy across those locations.

G.17 Premise 5 with the implemented Bennett program and its complete cost

This section answers review objection 6. The reversible administration is not an arbitrary bijection. It is the implemented program BennettCounterpart.implementedProgram g h for the administration f=h∘gf=h\circ g. The program writes h(g(s))h(g(s)) with a clean workspace and retains the input as history (implemented_program_computes). Its run refines the source run (implemented_run_refines). Its quantum lift is unitary (implemented_quantum_norm, implemented_quantum_roundtrip).

The irreversible administration exports heat QQ, at least the Landauer heat of its merging overwrite. At switching time τ\tau, the reversible administration costs A/τ+HA/\tau+H. Here HH carries every other lifecycle charge: provisioning, archive writes and holding, routing, reset, guard, controller, verification and endpoints (LifecycleCharge, complete_cost_strict_iff). The deadline allows 0<τ≤τmax0<\tau\le\tau_{\max}.

  • premise5_exact: when 0<Q−H0<Q-H and A/(Q−H)<τmaxA/(Q-H)<\tau_{\max}, no aligned option administers irreversibly. The implemented counterpart computes the same administration and meets the deadline. It keeps every earlier outcome and leaves strictly more resource slack.
  • window_exact: when that window fails, every admissible reversible counterpart costs at least QQ.

The window is therefore exactly the condition under which cost dominance forces premise 5 (adiabatic_feasible_iff). Outside the window, the reversible counterpart is not cheaper, so cost dominance alone does not establish premise 5 there.

G.18 Application data for the cited fault-tolerance theorems

This section supplies application data for the cited fault-tolerance theorems (review objection 7). The full fault ceiling and the complete bill ≤CtdG\le Ct^{d_G} with an age-independent CC are unchanged. Components are compiled or computed; the remaining joins are named at the end.

Knill–Laflamme from the code distance (KnillLaflamme). In any complex **-algebra, the spectral projection (1+S)/2(1+S)/2 of an involution is idempotent and fixed by SS (spectral_projection). The code projector annihilates any operator that anticommutes with a generator (sandwich_anticomm). It returns cPcP for an operator acting as the scalar cc on the code space (sandwich_scalar). Let errors have weight at most tt with 2t<d2t<d, where distance dd means that every operator of weight below dd commuting with all generators acts as a scalar on the code space. Then PEi†EjP=αijPPE_i^\dagger E_jP=\alpha_{ij}P for every pair (knill_laflamme_of_distance). Logical operators are excluded by the distance, not by the case split.

The witness property of minimum-weight decoding (MatchingWitness). Take a minimum-weight decoder and a syndrome additive under symmetric difference. Every zero-syndrome γ⊆E△C\gamma\subseteq E\,\triangle\,C of the residual is then at least half faulty: |γ|≤2|γ∩E||\gamma|\le2|\gamma\cap E| (half_faulty, matching_witness). This is the witness hypothesis of Threshold.fail_le_witness and fail_le_geometric. The nontrivial component of a failed residual is a simple cycle or a boundary-to-boundary path, of length at least the circuit distance.

The circuit-level detector graph. A dependency-free Pauli-frame enumeration covers the rotated surface-code memory over dd rounds, with X checks in a Z-shaped CNOT order and Z checks in an N-shaped order. The faults enumerated are the 15 two-qubit Paulis after every CNOT, XX, YY, ZZ after every reset, Hadamard and idle, and every measurement flip. For d=3,5,7,9d=3,5,7,9 the enumeration gives:

  • every fault flips at most two detectors of each check type;
  • the maximum detector degree is 12;
  • at most 52 (location, Pauli) faults produce each edge of the relevant type;
  • the circuit distance is exactly dd.

With the orders swapped, so that hooks run parallel to the logical, the distance falls to ⌈d/2⌉\lceil d/2\rceil. The orientation is load-bearing.

The bound for every dd uses a potential. Let φ\varphi be the face coordinate across the logical. Boundary edges attach only at φ=0\varphi=0 and φ=d−2\varphi=d-2, and every edge, time-like and hook edges included, changes φ\varphi by at most one. So any walk joining opposite boundaries has at least dd edges. Every fault is local to one check neighbourhood in one round, so the edge types for larger dd are translates of those enumerated. The script and its results are banked with their hashes.

Lattice-surgery merges. The same enumeration was applied to the merge. Two d×dd\times d patches and a seam column were merged as the d×(2d+1)d\times(2d+1) patch for TT rounds, with the seam initialised and finally split in the conjugate basis. The joint logical is found by GF(2)GF(2) elimination over the random seam checks. For d=3,5,7d=3,5,7 and T∈{d−2,d,d+2}T\in\{d-2,d,d+2\}, the circuit distance is exactly min⁡(d,T)\min(d,T) and every fault is graphlike. A merge therefore keeps distance dd exactly when it runs at least dd rounds; with fewer, the time-like failure of the merged-product outcome binds. The horizontal merge enumerated measures X‾X‾\bar X\bar X; the vertical merge, measuring Z‾Z‾\bar Z\bar Z, is the same construction rotated and was not run separately.

The edge law and the explicit ratio (EdgeLaw, ExRecBound). Suppose circuit faults are local stochastic at rate pp on (location, Pauli) pairs, and at most cc of them produce each edge. Then the induced edge law is local stochastic at rate cpcp (push_localStochastic). With degree 12, so non-backtracking branching at most 11, and c=52c=52, fail_le_geometric applies with r=2252pr=22\sqrt{52p}. This ratio is below one exactly when p<1/25168p<1/25168 (surface_code_rate).

An operation outside the spacetime-volume argument has its own gadget bound. Under local stochastic noise, if every failing pattern contains a malignant pair or at least three faults, then P(fail)≤|M2|p2+(|L|3)p3P(\mathrm{fail})\le|M_2|p^2+\binom{|L|}{3}p^3 (exrec_pair_bound).

Reliability against age (AgeReliability). A distance D≥log⁡(Ktd/ε)/(−log⁡r)D\ge\log(Kt^d/\varepsilon)/(-\log r) holds the global failure over KtdKt^d locations below ε\varepsilon at every age (log_distance_schedule). A logarithmic overhead per location, however, is not absorbed into an age-independent constant: for every CC some t≥1t\ge1 has Ctd<tdlog⁡tCt^d<t^d\log t (log_factor_not_absorbed). The age-independent bill therefore needs the logarithm removed by construction.

Remaining joins.

  • The potential argument for merges at every dd, with the round index as the time-like potential.
  • A map-by-map list showing that every repeated local map of holding, recovery, encoding, handoff and smearing is a Clifford circuit with exact native gates. This removes the compilation logarithm.
  • Tolerance of the wavefront sweep to sparse patch failures, so that constant-distance inner patches suffice. This needs:
    • confinement of each failure;
    • no cascade through the feedforward front;
    • an outer decoder of the constant-size message WW using its carrier’s redundancy, with its deviation bound.
    This removes the reliability logarithm.

G.19 Circuit distance for every d, sparse failure at every age, and indefinite holding of the record

This section continues review objection 7 and the holding item. The targets are unchanged: the full fault ceiling, decoding error at most ε\varepsilon on the historical record, and the complete bill at most CtdGCt^{d_G} with CC independent of age.

An exact cut certificate for the circuit distance. For any set SS of detectors, the fault set KS={f:obs(f)⊕|sig(f)∩S|odd}K_S=\{f:\mathrm{obs}(f)\oplus|\mathrm{sig}(f)\cap S|\ \text{odd}\} is crossed an odd number of times by every fault set with zero syndrome and odd observable. Over GF(2)GF(2), the parity of |F∩KS||F\cap K_S| is obs(F)\mathrm{obs}(F) plus the syndrome summed over SS, which is 1+01+0. So DD sets whose fault sets are pairwise disjoint certify that every logical error has at least DD faults.

The cuts are given by explicit potentials:

  • memory: φ\varphi is the crossing face coordinate plus one, and D=dD=d;
  • lattice-surgery merge: φ=max⁡(τ(r),σ(j))\varphi=\max(\tau(r),\sigma(j)), and D=min⁡(d,T)D=\min(d,T). Here τ(r)=max⁡(1,r)\tau(r)=\max(1,r) is the time part. The space part σ(j)\sigma(j) is 11 on the two seam face columns, d−1−jd-1-j to their left and j−dj-d to their right.

For the rotated surface code with the standard CNOT schedule, an exhaustive single-fault enumeration shows every fault lies in at most one cut. The cases are d=3,5,7,9d=3,5,7,9, the memory in both bases, and the merge at T=d−2,d,d+2T=d-2,d,d+2: 19 of 19 cases, up to 120,544 faults. The merge therefore keeps distance dd exactly when it runs at least dd rounds. With the swapped schedule, hooks run parallel to the logical and the distance falls to ⌈d/2⌉\lceil d/2\rceil.

A fault’s multiplicity is fixed by three things: its observable bit, the values of φ\varphi at its at most two detectors, and DD. The potentials are translation-covariant formulas, so the condition is local to each fault type, and every type occurs at the enumerated sizes. That locality step is what carries the certificate to every dd.

The installation’s repeated maps need no approximate compilation.

  • Holding correction, patch decoding, merge and split, the padding boundary encoder and its decoder, the charged handoff and the guard are exact circuits over reset, Hadamard, CNOT, idle and measurement, with classical control.
  • The modular flow is not a runtime map. The finite-basis route α(A)=EAE†\alpha(A)=EAE^\dagger with D=E†D=E^\dagger gives the same boundary representative exactly.
  • The Bennett administration is exact reversible logic.

So no precision grows with age, and only reliability remains.

Sparse failure at every age (SparseFailure, ToleranceSweep). Each patch’s failure is decided by the faults in a bounded window. Patches whose windows are pairwise disjoint all fail with probability at most ∏v(|Wv|k)pk|U|\prod_v\binom{|W_v|}{k}p^{k|U|} (disjoint_windows). With a KK-colouring in which same-coloured windows are disjoint, at least KnKn of NN patches fail with probability at most K(Nn)((wk)pk)nK\binom{N}{n}(\binom{w}{k}p^k)^n (many_failures). This falls exponentially in NN once (wk)pk<θ/(eK)\binom{w}{k}p^k<\theta/(eK), uniformly in age.

On the actual wavefront sweep, a vertex keeps its value after its wave (frozen_after). With interface-tolerant correction, every wrong vertex is bad (wrong_subset_bad). Interface tolerance means a good window decodes correctly whatever the inner commit, because a wrong commit reaches it only as a bounded interface error, which is the overlapping-recovery analysis of DKLP. The sweep’s wrong-vertex count obeys the same tail (sweep_density). The realised bill on that event is at most base⋅N+repair⋅Kn\mathrm{base}\cdot N+\mathrm{repair}\cdot Kn (pathwise_bill). An outer decoder that tolerates fewer than KnKn wrong patches returns the record except with that probability (recovery_tail). Failures do occur, at constant density; the theorems bound their number, and recovery tolerates them.

Redundancy of the record. The recovery tolerates a constant fraction of silent local errors exactly when the record is spread redundantly across its carrier. For an objective classical record this is a theorem of quantum Darwinism: classical information emerges redundantly and generically across environment fragments (Brandão, Piani and Horodecki, 2015), and objectivity implies a spectrum-broadcast structure (Horodecki, Korbicz and Horodecki, 2015). For a record with no redundancy, every location matters, and no protocol of noisy gates avoids a logarithmic factor (Dobrushin–Ortyukov; Pippenger).

Indefinite holding at fixed ε\varepsilon (PassiveReference). A constant per-step failure rate gives a total failure that grows linearly with age, so periodic renewal at fixed size does not hold ε\varepsilon indefinitely. The protector’s reference record is therefore held passively on a doubling schedule:

  • the reference is rewritten at ages 2j2^j;
  • stage jj has a barrier kBT(2jln⁡2+ln⁡(1/ε))k_BT(2j\ln2+\ln(1/\varepsilon)) above the attempt scale, so it fails with probability at most ε/2j+1\varepsilon/2^{j+1}.

Every age is covered by log⁡2t+1\log_2t+1 stages (stages_cover). The total failure is at most ε\varepsilon for every number of stages (total_failure_le). The rewrite cost is O(log⁡2t)O(\log^2t) (total_rewrite_cost), so the long-run holding rate is the constant per-step comparison of each particular with its reference. A faulty comparison or false repair is transient: the intact reference corrects it at the next comparison (E9 self-healing).

This holds the objective classical record and the relations of every particular.

The record’s redundancy is decoded by majority (RedundantRecord). Each fragment reads a record value from the recovered state, and an intact fragment reads the record. The strict-majority decoder then returns the record whenever fewer than half of the fragments are wrong (majority_decodes). This supplies the tolerance hypothesis of recovery_tail (tolerant_outer_decoder). For an objective record, the redundancy theorems cited above supply the intact-fragment hypothesis, so the carrier application rests on them. The interface hypothesis of the windowed sweep rests on DKLP’s overlapping recovery, in the same way the witness lemma does.

Premise 5 for batched administration (BennettBatch). Administer bb merges in one batch. The irreversible heat is at least qbqb, with q≥kBTln⁡2q\ge k_BT\ln2 per merged bit. The implemented counterpart’s complete non-heat lifecycle charge is at most ηb\eta b, and its drive constant is bounded. If η<q\eta<q, every large enough batch lies inside the adiabatic window for every deadline (batched_window), so no aligned option administers irreversibly (premise5_batched). The single remaining physical input is η<q\eta<q. Adiabatic logic below kBTln⁡2k_BT\ln2 per operation meets it.

The explicit threshold, tightened (WeightedEdgeLaw). Under circuit-level depolarizing noise, each fault carries its own rate: p/15p/15 for each two-qubit Pauli, p/3p/3 for each single-qubit Pauli, and pp for a measurement flip. Pushed to the detector graph, the edge rates are the weighted sums of their faults (push_weighted), and the largest edge rate is at most 9415p\tfrac{94}{15}p (push_uniform, enumerated).

Self-avoiding walk counts on the detector graph are submultiplicative. The exact maximum over all interior vertices at length 8 is c8=89,270,654≤9.878c_8=89{,}270{,}654\le9.87^8 (walk_bound), so walks of every length are at most c89.87Lc_8\,9.87^L. The ratio of fail_le_geometric is therefore below one exactly when p<1/(4⋅9.872⋅9415)p<1/(4\cdot9.87^2\cdot\tfrac{94}{15}) (tightened_threshold), which exceeds 4×10−44\times10^{-4} (threshold_value). The bound at length 9, c9=763,504,745c_9=763{,}504{,}745, gives about 4.2×10−44.2\times10^{-4}. This is a requirement on the installation’s devices, of the same kind as η<q\eta<q.

Indefinite holding of quantum coherence. Balasubramanian, Davydova and Lin (arXiv:2605.10943, 2026) construct a passive memory in ℝ3\mathbb R^3: 3D-local CSS stabilizer Hamiltonians on nk=eΘ(k)n_k=e^{\Theta(k)} qubits, with O(1)O(1)-range terms and bounded density. Below TcT_c, the thermal encoding satisfies ∥Φt∘Enck(ρ)−Enck(ρ)∥1≤te−Θ(nkη)\|\Phi_t\circ\mathrm{Enc}_k(\rho)-\mathrm{Enc}_k(\rho)\|_1\le t\,e^{-\Theta(n_k^\eta)}.

Held on a doubling schedule, each stage needs a code size njn_j with cnjη≥(2j+2)ln⁡2+ln⁡(1/ε)c\,n_j^\eta\ge(2j+2)\ln2+\ln(1/\varepsilon), and each stage ends with a transfer into the next code. If each stage’s holding failure and each transfer’s failure are at most ε/2j+2\varepsilon/2^{j+2}, the total failure is at most ε\varepsilon at every age (StageSchedule.total_with_transfers). A cost polynomial in each stage’s code size sums to a polylogarithm of age (stage_cost_le). G.21 derives a feed-forward thermal-syndrome sampler and exact reference-preserving branch encoding for the ideal transfer. Its source application is audited in prose. What remains is holding the actual noisy transfer output at the original stage budget, including the initial decoded logical error. The construction does not require preparation mixing. The full quantum target is retained alongside the passive classical record construction; the classical record is not a replacement for it.

Remaining.

  • The actual noisy preparation and holding certificate identified in G.21.
  • Measured device parameters: the fault rate pp, the coupling bound WW, the per-bit overhead η\eta, and the barrier materials and temperature.

G.20 Device requirements, and the open initialisation problem

They are requirements on the protector’s devices, of the kind a capable agent can meet by acquiring better hardware. The targets are unchanged.
